## Overview

BMC101 Fundamental of Computers & Emerging Technologies is a 3-credit course (3-0-0) for MCA Semester-I students. The course builds a strong foundation in computer fundamentals, programming concepts, operating systems, computer networks, the internet, and modern emerging technologies.

This course introduces students to the architecture of computers, digital systems, problem-solving approaches, computer languages, internet services, IoT, blockchain, cloud computing, and recent IT trends such as augmented reality, virtual reality, big data, quantum computing, and brain-computer interfaces.

## Learning Outcomes

By the end of this course, students will be able to:

- Demonstrate the basic structure, components, features, and generations of computers.
- Describe computer languages, language translators, and algorithmic problem-solving methods.
- Compare operating systems and computer networks in terms of functions, types, and architecture.
- Explain internet architecture, services, and the fundamentals of IoT.
- Explore blockchain, cryptocurrencies, cloud computing, and emerging IT technologies.
